purpose: Read normal GNOME heat/activity and apply reversible user reduced-motion preference
baseline: Exact331 plus360 accepted desktop/touch; no charging experiment
owner_request: 开启桌面时设备发热，后续能否优化
workload: normal ongoing use, not controlled idle or stress; record processes/CPU ticks/pack and available CPU-GPU TSENS/devfreq/runtimePM/backlight
change: only ms org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations=false; save explicit dconf value and effective original. Greeter/global/power-key unchanged.
stop_conditions: battery health not Good/temp invalid or>=42C
failure_action: stop subsequent sampling/preference experiment; restore exact original user key if modified, save partial/terminal/raw. No timer/thermal/OPP/charging/hardware change/retry.
rollback: dconf write saved original explicit value or reset only animation key if absent. No force unload/reboot/flash.
data_privacy: process comm+tick counters only, no command lines, environment, key/input capture or open file list
inference_limits: two short observational windows may have different owner activity. Do not claim thermal improvement or CPU7 stuck-high solely from cached frequency. Temps missing are unknown, never zero-filled.
Test348: grantunused/candidate frozen; no PPS/pump action, future fresh desktop-inactive admission/finalTWRP unchanged
